title: Differentiation of human iPSC to neural stem cells
author: Malin Andersson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgbxjspn
materials: Prepare primary antibodies (Table 1): Towards the end of the blocking time, dilute primary antibodies in 1% DS and mix by using a pipette (keep on ice until needed). If using the antibodies suggested in table 1, the anti-OCT4 stain can be co-stained with any of the NSC markers. Antibody Dilution Catalogue Number Supplier Rabbit Anti-PAX6 1:200 60433S Cell Signalling Technology Rabbit Anti-FOXG1 1:2000 ab196868 Abcam Mouse Anti-OCT4 1:100 sc-5279 Santa Cruz

Aspirate blocking buffer and add the primary antibodies (50µl per well for a 96 well plate, or 1ml per well for a 6 well plate). Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature. We recommend having a no primary control sample which are only stained with the secondary antibody. Add 1% DS to these wells during this step.

Prepare secondary antibodies (Table 2) in 1% DS and add DAPI at a dilution of 1:1000. Pipette to mix. Keep on ice in the dark until needed. Antibody Dilution Catalogue Number Supplier Donkey Anti-Rabbit AF488 1:1000 A21206 Invitrogen Donkey Anti-Mouse AF647 1:1000 A31571 Invitrogen DAPI 386 1:1000 40043 Biotium

Aspirate PBS and add the secondary antibodies (50µl per well for a 96 well plate, or 1ml per well for a 6 well plate). Incubate in the dark (wrapped in foil or in a dark box) for 1 hour at room temperature.
Aspirate media and wash cells with DPBS(-/-).

steps.title: Coat plates with vitronectin (1:50)
steps.instruction: Dilute vitronectin 1:50 in DPBS(-/-), add enough to each well of a Falcon 6‑well plate to cover the surface, and incubate for at least 2 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare E6 base media
steps.instruction: Weigh 64 mg L‑ascorbic acid, 1 g NaCl, and 543 mg NaHCO₃ into a 50 mL Falcon tube, add 500 mL DMEM/F12, rinse the tube with additional DMEM/F12 to recover all powder, combine with a second 500 mL DMEM/F12 in a 1 L filter unit, filter, mix thoroughly, aliquot, and store at –80 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Make E8 seeding media with Y‑27632
steps.instruction: Supplement complete E8 medium with Y‑27632 (rock inhibitor) to a final concentration of 10 µM; prepare enough for 2 mL per well for replating.

steps.title: Reconstitute small‑molecule stocks
steps.instruction: Reconstitute SB431542 and XAV939 to 10 mM each in DMSO (store aliquots at –20 °C for up to 6 months); reconstitute LDN193189 to 1 mM in DMSO (store aliquots at –20 °C until the expiry date on the vial).

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Media (NIM)
steps.instruction: Thaw E6 base media, add 2 mL Insulin‑Transferrin‑Selenium (ITS) per 100 mL E6, then add 100 µL SB431542, 20 µL XAV939 and 10 µL LDN193189 per 100 mL E6 (final concentrations 10 µM SB431542, 2 µM XAV939, 0.1 µM LDN193189). Keep the medium in the dark, store at 4 °C for up to 12 days, and bring to room temperature before use (avoid direct sunlight).

steps.title: Prepare Neural Maintenance Media (NMM)
steps.instruction: Make NMM as described in the lab’s standard recipe; if preparing large volumes, filter through a filter unit. Store at 4 °C and use within 14 days.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Freeze Media
steps.instruction: Combine Neural Maintenance Media (90 %) with DMSO (10 %); use 1 mL of this freeze media per 2.5 × 10⁶ cells.

steps.title: Passage iPSC for neural induction
steps.instruction: Aspirate existing iPSC medium, wash each well with 2 mL DPBS(-/-), aspirate DPBS, add 1 mL Accutase per well, and incubate 3–6 min at 37 °C (check after 3 min for detachment). Add 4 mL E8 medium per well, pipette up‑and‑down with a stripette to dislodge cells, collect all wells into a 50 mL Falcon tube, and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Determine cell count with a cell counter.
Calculate volume needed to seed 2 × 10⁶ cells per well (0.2 × 10⁶ cells / cm²).
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL E8 + 10 µM Y‑27632 for each 2 × 10⁶ cells.
Quickly remove the vitronectin from a freshly 1:100‑coated 6‑well plate and add 2 mL cell suspension to each well.
Gently shake plate back‑and‑forth and side‑to‑side to distribute cells evenly.
Transfer plate to a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator and culture overnight.

steps.title: Day 0 neural induction media change
steps.instruction: Aspirate the overnight E8 medium, gently wash cells with 2 mL DPBS(-/-), aspirate DPBS, and add 2 mL Neural Induction Media (NIM) to the side of each well; return plate to the incubator (this is day 0 of induction).

steps.title: Daily neural induction media changes
steps.instruction: Replace NIM with 2–3 mL fresh NIM per well every 24 hours for 10 days. Monitor cells: by day 3 a neuroepithelial sheet should be visible; by day 10 neural rosette structures may appear.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer with DNAse I
steps.instruction: Make fresh wash buffer by mixing DMEM/F12+Glutamax with DNAse I to a final concentration of 0.03 mg/mL; prepare this for each cell line just before use.

steps.title: Passage cells to Neural Maintenance Media
steps.instruction: Aspirate NIM, wash each well with 2 mL DPBS(-/-), aspirate DPBS, add 1 mL Accutase per well, and incubate 3–6 min at 37 °C (check after 3 min). While incubating, prepare the wash buffer (see previous step). After incubation, add 4 mL wash buffer to each well, pipette up‑and‑down with a stripette to detach cells, collect all wells into a 50 mL Falcon tube, mix thoroughly, and aliquot into equal‑volume 15 mL Falcon tubes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 × g, 5 min, room temperature.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend pellet in 4 mL NMM supplemented with 10 µM Y‑27632 per well (1:1 passage, same number of wells as in induction).
Quickly remove vitronectin from a freshly 1:100‑coated plate and add 4 mL cell suspension to each well.
Agitate plate back‑and‑forth and side‑to‑side, then incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Culture in Neural Maintenance Media
steps.instruction: Change media every 24 hours with 2–3 mL fresh NMM per well until day 10 of maintenance. Cells should proliferate, remain as a small‑round/oval neuroepithelial sheet, and may form rosette structures around day 10.

steps.title: Harvest cells for downstream analysis or freezing
steps.instruction: If RNA‑Seq or qPCR is planned, isolate the required suspension volume into separate 15 mL Falcon tubes (minimum 2 × 10⁶ cells per pellet).

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media, wash gently with 2 mL DPBS(-/-) per well, aspirate DPBS, add 1 mL Accutase per well, and incubate 4 min at 37 °C (check after 2 min).
Neutralise Accutase by adding 4 mL DMEM/F12+Glutamax per well, pipette up‑and‑down to dissociate cells.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 µm filter into a 50 mL Falcon tube.

Count cells; for cryopreservation, resuspend 1 mL Neural Freeze Media per 2.5 × 10⁶ cells, aliquot 1 mL into each 1.8 mL cryovial, place vials in a controlled‑rate freezing container (CoolCell) and store at –80 °C for 24 h before transfer to liquid N₂.

steps.title: Thaw and re‑plate frozen NSCs
steps.instruction: Partially thaw cryovials in a 37 °C water bath, add 1 mL DMEM/F12+Glutamax dropwise to the vial, transfer to a fresh tube containing 7 mL DMEM/F12+Glutamax, wash the vial with an additional 1 mL DMEM/F12+Glutamax, and combine all.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 rcf for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate supernatant and gently resuspend the pellet in 4 mL NMM supplemented with 10 µM Y‑27632 and 20 ng/mL bFGF.
If the vial contained >1.5 × 10⁶ cells, seed the entire volume into one well of a 6‑well plate; otherwise count cells and seed at 0.15–0.25 × 10⁶ cells / cm² (≈1.5–2.5 × 10⁶ cells per well).
Remove vitronectin from a freshly 1:100‑coated plate, add 4 mL cell suspension to each well, gently agitate back‑and‑forth, and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Post‑thaw culture of NSCs
steps.instruction: 24 h after plating, aspirate spent medium and replace with 4 mL fresh NMM containing 20 ng/mL bFGF. Thereafter change medium every other day with NMM + bFGF; passage cells after 4–6 days when confluent.

steps.title: Immunocytochemistry (ICC) fixation
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium and add 4 % formaldehyde in PBS with Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺; incubate 20 min at room temperature in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate formaldehyde and wash cells twice with PBS + Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, 5 min each wash.
Replace with fresh PBS and wrap plate in parafilm; store at 4 °C for up to 7 days before staining.

steps.title: Permeabilisation and blocking
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in PBS + Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ (store ≤1 month at 4 °C). Prepare 10 % donkey serum (DS) in 0.1 % Triton X‑100. Aspirate PBS, add 10 % DS to each well, and incubate 2 h at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10 % DS to 1 % DS with 0.1 % Triton X‑100 (e.g., 1 mL 10 % DS + 9 mL 0.1 % Triton).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation and washes
steps.instruction: Aspirate blocking solution, add primary antibody (as per supplier’s dilution) and incubate as required. Then wash three times with PBS + Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, 5 min each wash at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation and washes
steps.instruction: Aspirate primary antibody, add appropriate fluorophore‑conjugated secondary antibody, incubate in the dark at room temperature (time as per supplier). Wash twice with PBS, 5 min each wash, keeping plates protected from light.

steps.title: Final storage and imaging
steps.instruction: Replace the final wash with fresh PBS, wrap plates in parafilm, and store at 4 °C in the dark. Analyse fluorescence by microscopy or high‑content imaging; expect NSC markers (PAX6, FOXG1, Nestin) and absence of OCT4 in differentiated cells.

steps.title: Prepare cell pellets for RNA‑Seq/qPCR
steps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant from harvested cells, resuspend pellet in DPBS(-/-), divide into Eppendorf tubes, centrifuge 30 s to pellet, aspirate supernatant, snap‑freeze pellets, and store at –80 °C.
